findings.text: Packet checksum intake provides paired setup and final validation forms, including variants that accept a zero field and a generic form that uses a null pseudo header routine. The shared logic clears the validity marker and only invokes completion when a need predicate holds, passing a pseudo value supplied by the caller. Completion confirms an existing complete mark by folding, otherwise stores the pseudo and either finishes immediately when forced or the packet is short, or defers.

Checksum state cycles among none, complete and partial. A complete mark validates when the folded combination is zero and otherwise falls through to store the pseudo. A none state paired with a valid flag can be promoted to complete with an inverted pseudo. Partial mode records a start position and length derived from a base pointer and supplied bounds. Forwarding demotes complete to none, while a reset forces none and clears a non internet indicator when that option exists.

Remote checksum handling branches on a flag. One branch installs partial mode directly from given start and offset values. The other branch ensures complete materialization, accounts for bytes already pulled past the data pointer, then merges a delta computed over the modified region into the stored checksum.

Extension storage pairs a reference count with an offset table indexed by extension identifier, a total chunk count, and a trailing payload aligned to eight bytes. Both the per entry offsets and the total use eight byte units.

Extension presence uses a packet bit mask together with nonzero offsets in shared storage. Existence checks test the mask or the offset, lookup scales the stored offset to bytes, deletion only acts when present, reset releases and clears the mask, and copy shares storage with an added reference after releasing any prior destination store. Builds without the feature replace these with empty operations or constant false.

Tracking attachment access offers a masked pointer view, a raw integer view, and a setter that records presence in a slow path marker and warns on overwrite of a live entry. Without the tracking option the views yield null or zero and the setter does nothing.

Filter state cleanup releases any tracked connection and clears the slot, while trace and virtual server markers are cleared only when their options exist. Copying transfers the tracking slot with an added reference, duplicates the trace marker when requested, and mirrors the slow path flag after releasing any prior destination reference.
Security label handling either copies an integer tag between packets and zeroes it on init, or compiles to empty operations when the option is absent.

Queue identity management sets and copies the transmit value directly. Receive recording stores hardware index plus one so that zero means unrecorded, retrieval subtracts one, and a predicate tests nonzero. A separate destination confirmation value is written from an integer and read as a boolean.

Offload helpers inspect the shared type field for sixth generation internet and for message stream protocols, clear size segment count and type together on reset, and grow or shrink size by a delta with a one time warning and no change when fragment mode is indicated.

A forwarding check treats a scattered packet with nonzero offload size but empty type as large receive offload and emits a warning. A debug assertion warns unless checksum state is none. Header exclusive access is reported locked when the shared fragment indicator is clear or the buffer is cloned.

Redirect tracking reports a flag, sets it with an ingress indicator, and clears it on reset. One set form also clears timing on ingress when redirection support exists, while a no clear form preserves timing. Companion accessors report message stream checksum mode, force checksum state to none while clearing that mode, exchange coverage handles, and set a recycle hint only with page pool support.

Local combination for layered checksums starts from the complement of the inner stored value found at the checksum offset and folds in the header bytes between the transport base and the checksum start.

Fragment storage lifetime acquires a counted reference on the backing memory and releases it on unreference, returning the page to a pool when recycling is requested and accepted. Packet level release by index skips buffers under managed zero copy and otherwise honors the packet recycle hint.
Socket diagnostic dispatch pairs an owner reference with a family tag and three operations for bulk listing, single socket detail, and teardown handling.
Legacy internet diagnostic compatibility couples an owner reference with a single request handler.
Socket cookie retrieval brackets the underlying generation with a preemption guard and returns a wide integer token.

Teardown notification grouping maps fourth and sixth generation internet sockets with stream or datagram protocols to dedicated groups, while raw sockets and any other family or protocol yield no group.
Teardown listener presence needs a meaningful group for the socket plus an existing diagnostic channel in the owning network context that has subscribers for that group.

Address containers include a fixed form with family and fourteen payload bytes, a flexible form with family and open tail, an alias for the largest storage, a family type alias, and a linger control with switch and duration. A build time check ensures a given length fits the largest storage.

Messaging descriptors distinguish kernel and user layouts plus a batch wrapper. The kernel layout carries address reference and length, remaining input length, payload iterator, a control union for kernel or user memory with selector, inquiry request flag, received flags, control length, auxiliary completion reference and scatter construction callback. The user layout carries user address, vector array and control references with counts and flags. The batch wrapper joins one user header with a transfer length.
Ancillary header carries total extent including itself, a level identifying the originator, and a kind code specific to that level.

Ancillary sizing and walk align extents to machine word, separate padded space from unpadded length, expose payload start for kernel and user viewers, find the first entry only with sufficient remaining bytes, step by aligned extent with overrun producing null, accept an entry only when its extent covers a header and stays within remaining control, offer a loop over all entries, and report leftover payload through the iterator.
Ancillary kinds are numbered one through four for access rights, process credentials, security label and process descriptor, with the credential payload holding three thirty two bit identity values.
Extension identifiers are optionally compiled per networking feature and always end with a numeric count marker that must stay last.

Security path presence checks the dedicated extension when that option is built and otherwise reports absent, with a lookup returning the stored path or null. Release in interrupt context is permitted only absent a destructor, security path, tracking entry, destination reference and fragment list.
Diagnostic handling enters through bulk, detail and teardown callbacks registered per family, plus a legacy internet callback for older requests.
Each header defines a unique inclusion guard macro to prevent repeated processing of buffer reference, diagnostic and socket definitions.
